title: Email
description: Connect your mailbox and work from a local-first cache. Only headers are fetched first; bodies and attachments load on demand.

account.title: Your mailboxes
account.help: Mailboxes are private to you. Passwords are encrypted on the server and never shown again.
account.label: Mailbox name
account.passwordHint: Stored encrypted; leave blank to keep the current password.
account.removeConfirm: Remove this mailbox from CRM? Cached mail on this device stays until you clear browser data.
account.labelHint: Shown next to each message so you know which mailbox it came from.
account.emailHint: Type only the part before @ and {suffix} is added for you.
account.passwordHintNew: The mailbox password from your email provider. Stored encrypted; never shown again.
account.usernameHint: Leave blank to use the full email address, which is what 263 and Simply.com expect.
account.advancedHint: Filled in automatically for known providers. Only change them if your provider gave you different values.
account.secureHint: On: port {on}. Off: port {off} with STARTTLS. Unencrypted logins are never allowed.
account.colorHint: Colour of the dot shown next to this mailbox.
account.duplicate: You already added a mailbox with this address.
account.customHint: Enter the IMAP and SMTP servers from your provider under “Server settings”.
account.afterSave: After saving, open the Mail tab: the newest 100 inbox headers are downloaded and the mailbox then refreshes automatically about once a minute while this page is open.

providerHint.263: Server settings are filled in automatically. Use the password of your 263 mailbox.
providerHint.simply: Server settings are filled in automatically (mail.simply.com / smtp.simply.com). Use the password set for this mailbox in the Simply.com control panel (Mail Administration).

testErrors.auth: Login or password rejected. Use the full email address as login and the mailbox password from your provider.
testErrors.host: Server not found. Check the host name under “Server settings”.
testErrors.refused: The server refused the connection. Check the port.
testErrors.timeout: No answer from the server. Check host, port and your network or firewall.
testErrors.tls: Encryption mismatch. Ports 993/465 need “Encrypted connection” on; ports 143/587 need it off.
testErrors.unknown: Connection failed. Check host, port and encryption.

list.noAccountsHint: Add a 263 or simply mailbox to start reading email.
